#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <regex>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;
    int prev = -1;
    int maxOutside = 0;
    int insideWords = 0;
    bool inside = false;
    regex delimiter("[_()]");
    smatch matcher;
    string::const_iterator searchStart(s.cbegin());
    while (regex_search(searchStart, s.cend(), matcher, delimiter)) {
        int i = distance(s.cbegin(), matcher[0].first);
        char c = s[i];
        int segmentLength = i - prev - 1;
        if (c == '_' && !inside) {
            maxOutside = max(maxOutside, segmentLength);
        } else if (c == '_' && inside) {
            if (segmentLength > 0) insideWords++;
        } else if (c == '(') {
            inside = true;
            maxOutside = max(maxOutside, segmentLength);
        } else if (c == ')') {
            inside = false;
            if (segmentLength > 0) insideWords++;
        }
        prev = i;
        searchStart = matcher[0].second;
    }
    maxOutside = max(maxOutside, (int)(s.length() - prev - 1));
    cout << maxOutside << " " << insideWords << endl;
    return 0;
}
